title: Google expands AI Search ads globally as core ad growth slows
hook_text: Google just monetized global AI search
script:
Google just expanded its AI Search ads to users everywhere.
Parent company Alphabet just posted its third quarter earnings report.
Total revenue grew twenty five percent year over year.
That brought total quarterly revenue to one hundred twenty seven point six billion dollars.
The global ad rollout arrives as traditional search ad growth slows down.
Commercial ads now display directly inside conversational AI search summaries.
Will you buy products recommended by conversational search ads?
